goal: Add an additive, service-only HTS dual-model debate audit table and immutable typed promotion provenance without changing existing precedent classifications or enabling automatic Apply.
prohibited_actions: Do not read or publish licensed product descriptions or raw provider payloads.
Do not infer or backfill human_review for existing precedents; they remain legacy_unspecified.
Do not grant anon or authenticated access to hts_rag_debate_runs and do not grant DELETE to any application role.
Do not make RAG operative, alter authoritative duty rates, enable automatic Apply, or change DesignFlow application code.
Do not apply to preview or production, request review, open or merge a pull request, or release the claim without orchestrator instruction.
assumptions: The production catalog at project qsllyeztdwjgirsysgai is the current deployed public HTS RAG contract and all referenced HTS tables are local to one Postgres database.
The new table remains an audit record with service_role SELECT, INSERT, and bounded column UPDATE only; DELETE is unavailable.
Existing precedent review_state values and review-event rows do not, by themselves, prove a durable row-specific human_review promotion basis.
Automatic recommendation remains separate from manual Apply, and this migration does not mutate RFQ duty fields.
stop_conditions: Stop if implementation requires any database object outside claim 2581 or a destructive rewrite of existing rows.
Stop if the foreign keys cannot remain within the same public-schema Postgres connection.
Stop if preserving existing rows requires guessing human review provenance.
Stop before external review, preview, pull-request creation, merge, production promotion, or DesignFlow application edits.
